title: 2019-09-06 Meeting notes - Evaluation of GitHub
content:
Date

Attendees

  • Tayseer El tarifi

Goal

  • Status of decisions regarding artifact repository: Azure Artifacts + Azure Container Registry OR JFrog Artifactory (or other)
  • IKEA Life at Home Cloud: scope, status etc. with regards to artifact repository management

Discussion items

Tayseer is working on documenting the CBF DevOps approach. We looked at a slid that showed current recommendation of tooling to implement DevOps.
The list of tools is under development and we will work together finding the core tooling.
AWS is not in the picture as a platform. Most IPEX projects are using AWS as the platform and there is no business case, at least short term, to change platform.
We must have a way of supporting tools and platforms used by existing platform, one example is nKP that needs AWS; Jira/Confluence/Bitbucket.
Going forward Azure is the first choice. If you have business case you can as well use GCP
We have a multi cloud strategy.
Cloud landing page will be available on line where all services and guidelines will be available.
Regarding Artifactory vs JFrog. Artifactory is the chosen tool. If there is a business case to use other tool we can discuss.
There has been a previous discussion regarding access to CBF GitHub Enterprise. Ulrika provided the cost center. We will name the repository IPEX.
The persons at, at lest internally supporting, will be David and Joakim

There are discussions ongoing regarding ways of working and that CBF will have a
Self service model - Business takes responsibility for application
Assisted service - Business provides requirements and then DevOps is delivered

We should set a date for a more detailed walk through. We will book a day and set agenda together.
Work together developing the implementation of DevOps ways of working.

Contacts:
 - questions regarding infrastructure
Tayseer El tarifi - questions rearing CBF DevOps WoW
Jathisan Chandrasegaram - questions regarding tools
 - IPEX DevOps enabler
 - IPEX DevOps enabler

After meeting discussion with :
IKEA life at home cloud - vs KOMPIS what is current status
Developer.inter.IKEA.com domain as permalink to use as entry point for all documentation.
Example combine KOMPIS components to fetch product data and models via DEXF and show in 3D scene component using a DevOps setup.
If we can make such a demo we have as well shown that boarding the the DevOps and platform is excellent.
